procedure: State: The same bundle also supplies measured, overlapping impression-count sequences with documented annual increments and common disturbances. Procedure: Triangulate dates and shift the long ordered count patterns against overlapping references, explicitly test omitted/duplicated increments, and record alignments that satisfy the supplied measurement tolerance and independent anchors. Limits and stopping conditions: Repeated patterns, measurement error, weak shared disturbance, uncertain anchors and nonunique gaps limit dating.

inferential_warrant: The measured alignment constrains increment positions; the independently documented impression-to-letter relation supplies only its bounded writing interval. A gap is an observed alignment requirement, not automatically an intentional omission.
problem_decomposition: Keep letter dating as the task; increment positions are the measurement units needed for the one new relational observable.
next_inquiry: Return to ordinary independent-anchor checking and report alternative intervals; no new adaptive request rule.
